description: Publish posts about 1–3 trend snapshots to the given connected accounts, scheduled five minutes from now — one post per content hook per account, written from the trend's hooks. This puts real content in front of a real audience almost immediately and the user does not see the text first: show them get_trends' hooks and get explicit approval. Prefer queue_trend_drafts when they want to review.

connected_account_ids.description: Connected account UUIDs to post to — from list_connections.

name: schedule_trend_posts
